<!-- pr-reviewer: baeebe4631498566c6205a94bd699b2be1b5516a -->
Needs changes before merge.

The row check uses both the entity and the feature. The mark is temporary view state. It does not send a command. The new face test passed.

Local results:
- Trial merge with upstream/main 703af8185f7cfc574050d0187502b4b42d6b67eb failed in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`. I stopped the merge and tested the unchanged PR head. These results do not verify a merged tree.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 775 passed, 5 ignored.
- Integration tests: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, feedback 6, fixtures 7, gpu_render 11 (1 ignored), machine 6, models 4, operations 31, shell 21, sinker_setup 1, theme_files 14. All passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:182`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the row at rest, the marked row when the pointer is over its selected feature, and the row after the pointer leaves. The body has no screenshots for this visible UI change.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs:99`: Resolve the merge conflict with current main when this PR reaches its merge turn. Keep the row-state clear and the main changes. The file also changes all line endings; keep the main line endings to reduce the diff. Run the UI checks again after the merge.

Notes: This change does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision and gouge checks. No golden files changed. I did not run mutations. The test covers a face; chain and vertex cases have no direct test in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the screenshot and line-ending findings in d7f7b237ee8c632234fae67a0945cf057ee76c78.

1. The PR body now shows before and after Geometry rows at rest, while hovering the selected face, and after leaving. The captures use the real row drawing and face picking in `geo_row_hover::viewport_hover_over_a_picked_face_marks_its_row`. They are cropped harness captures, not full GPU viewport screenshots. The before images temporarily suppress the outline. Capture code is not committed. Removing row marking made the pin RED. Restoring it made the pin GREEN.
2. `shell.rs` now keeps main's CRLF line endings. Its PR diff is the intended row-state clear. A byte check rejected LF-only bytes and passed after restoration. Removing the clear made the same face pin RED. Restoring it made the pin GREEN. The semantic conflict remains deferred to the merge turn, as the review requests. This pass did not merge.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 885 tests passed and 6 ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review the new head d7f7b237ee8c632234fae67a0945cf057ee76c78.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d7f7b237ee8c632234fae67a0945cf057ee76c78 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The row check uses both the entity and the feature. The mark is temporary view state. It clears each frame and sends no command.

The previous requests are complete. The PR body now has before and after images at rest, over the selected face, and after leaving. The images show the row outline. They are panel captures from the test harness. The shell file keeps main's line endings. The trial merge has no conflicts.

Local results, with upstream/main a89d47128d33d3793e7871cc95f311892a672397 merged into the PR head:
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=6`, from `crates/ui`: 911 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- Library: 785 passed, 5 ignored. Main: 1 passed.
- Integration tests: boundary 3; boundary_picks 6; edge_loop_pick 3; egui_app 3; feedback 6; fixtures 7; gpu_render 11 (1 ignored); machine 6; models 4; operations 31; shell 21; sinker_setup 1; theme_files 14; trace_composite 4; trace_parity 5. All passed. Doc tests: 0.
- The new face-hover test passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: This change does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision and gouge checks. No golden files changed. I did not run mutations. The new test covers a face. It does not directly test the chain and vertex cases. All checks ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
